text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Thank you for giving me some time off.
choice_data_list: Were you able to get some good rest?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes... Heading to my favorite café to read historical novels...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Enveloped in the aroma of coffee...
it was a very peaceful time.
Though...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: If only I had someone to share it with...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No, please forget what I said...
It was terribly embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looks like Still in Love was able to have a fulfilling day off.
